{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm that revenue has commas by checking for them
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print("Number of revenue entries with commas:", has_commas.sum())

# Check one example
print("Example of a revenue value with comma:", sales.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].iloc[0])"}
